jobs.description:
An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

Are you an experienced .NET Architect who enjoys guiding development teams, shaping technical strategy, and modernizing complex enterprise applications?

We're looking for a Senior .NET Architect to lead the technical vision of a portfolio of business-critical applications within a highly innovative and future-oriented environment.

Your role

• Define and drive architectural decisions across multiple development teams
• Coach and support experienced Full Stack .NET developers
• Lead modernization initiatives, including migration to .NET 10 and cloud-native architectures
• Help shape the transition towards Kubernetes-based platforms
• Coordinate technical work within Agile/Scrum teams
• Challenge technical and functional decisions to ensure scalable, maintainable solutions
Tech Stack

• C# / .NET 10 & .NET Framework
• Blazor
• SQL Server & MongoDB
• RabbitMQ
• Hangfire
• Clean Architecture
• NServiceBus → Dapr
• Microservices
What we're looking for:

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect
• Strong background in enterprise application architecture
• Experience leading and coaching development teams
• Excellent analytical and communication skills
• Fluent in English and strong knowledge of Dutch or French
Extra:

• Location: Brussels (Hybrid)
• On-site: 2 days/week
• Remote: 3 days/week
• Long-term assignment
This is an opportunity to work on large-scale software solutions that support critical infrastructure while driving architectural innovation and modernization across multiple development teams.

Interested or know someone who might be a fit? Feel free to reach out!

-

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join a team developing advanced automation and software solutions for industrial environments.

Responsabilities

• Design and develop applications using .NET Core and Visual Studio.
• Create functional and technical designs, including UML diagrams and interface specifications.
• Work in an Agile/Scrum environment with CI/CD practices.
• Define and execute test plans, simulations, and system testing.
• Support commissioning and integration testing activities.
• Prepare technical and user documentation.

Requirements

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Informatics, Electronics, or equivalent experience.
• Experience with C# .NET development in Windows and/or Linux environments.
• Knowledge of Oracle, MySQL, or SQL Server databases is a plus.
• Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or Docker.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Team-oriented, proactive, and detail-focused mindset.
• Willingness to travel for occasional on-site activities.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good command of English.
 

If you are passionate about software engineering and enjoy working on challenging, technology-driven projects, we would love to hear from you. Feel free to share your resumee with us on CV@talencia.eu

Do you have experience in woodworking and take pride in delivering high-quality craftsmanship?

We are looking for a Production Worker Woodworking to help manufacture and assemble bespoke kitchens and custom-made furniture in a modern production environment.

Salary: starting at 17 euro bruto per hour   meal vouchers

• Producing and assembling custom kitchens and fixed furniture solutions.
• Working on high-end interior projects with great attention to detail and finishing quality.
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.
• Operating woodworking machinery and tools.
• Contributing to an efficient and smooth production process.

• You have completed a technical or vocational education in woodworking.
• You have previous experience as a woodworker, cabinet maker, or production worker in a similar role.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• You possess strong technical skills and practical insight.
• You work in an organized and structured manner.
• You are flexible and able to perform well under pressure.
• You communicate fluently in English.
• You enjoy working as part of a team but can also work independently when required.

Our client is one of the world's leading logistics companies.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system.
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items.
• Registering goods correctly in the system.
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse.
• You will work in a cold environment.

Who are we looking for?

• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment.
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn.
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night).
• You speak and understand English well.
• You have your own means of transportation.

Are you passionate about meat processing and quality? For a modern and growing company in the meat industry located in the Waregem region, we are looking for motivated deboners to strengthen the production team.
Your responsibilities
• 
Deboning and cutting pork meat 

• 
Correct use of knives and work equipment 

• 
Working according to hygiene and safety regulations 

• 
Quality control of products 

• 
Collaborating within a dynamic production environment

Your profile
• 
Experience as a deboner, butcher, or meat processing worker is a plus 

• 
You work accurately and with attention to quality 

• 
You are motivated and not afraid of physical work 

• 
You can work independently as well as in a team

Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English is an advantage

Respect for hygiene and safety is essential

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Do you have experience working in a slaughterhouse and are you skilled with a knife? We are looking for a versatile slaughterhouse worker for a client in Westrozebeke. You will work on the slaughter line, carrying out your tasks accurately and safely.

Your tasks

• 
Carrying out various tasks on the slaughter line, depending on your experience and skills.

• 
Removing red and white offal and extracting intestinal packages.

• 
Trimming tenderloin and removing excess fat.

• 
Working with various slaughterhouse tools and equipment.

• 
Following regulations regarding animal welfare, food safety and hygiene.

• 
You are skilled with a knife and have experience in at least one position within a slaughterhouse.

• 
You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

• 
You pay attention to safety and hygiene.

• 
You are physically fit for production work on a slaughter line.

• 
Languages: Dutch, French or English.

• 
You can arrange your own transport to work (public transport is not available).

• 
You are available to start at 5:30 AM and work until the end of the shift.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a quality inspector for a company based in Lokeren.
 

You will be responsible for inspecting, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work day shifts in a technical environment, with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 
- Check technical drawings and ensure that all parts are complete. 
- Carry out minor tasks such as removing rust and applying touch-up paint. 
- Prepare parts for shipment. 
- Process and register parts using the company's internal computer system.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking. 
- You work accurately and in a structured manner, with an eye for detail. 
- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems. 
- You are a hands-on team player and speak either Dutch or English.

Our client is one of the world's leading specialist HR consultancies. Help candidates build meaningful careers and support businesses in finding the talent they need to succeed. Joining the Brussels office means becoming part of a high-performing, collaborative team where entrepreneurship, development, and achievement are celebrated every day.

Jobomschrijving

jobs.occupation: Technical Service Manager - Industrial Technology Leader
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group specializing in environmental solutions for highly regulated industries. To support the growth of its aftermarket activities, the company is looking for a Service Manager to lead service operations in Belgium, develop long-term customer relationships and drive recurring service revenue through maintenance, inspections and technical support.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and coordinate daily service activities across Belgium
• Plan and optimize technician schedules and field interventions
• Manage external contractors and service partners
• Conduct technical inspections and customer visits
• Identify improvement opportunities and prepare service proposals
• Develop and expand maintenance and service contracts within existing accounts
• Ensure high service quality, safety and customer satisfaction
• Support the future growth of the service department and service offering

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering or similar technical field
• Minimum 10 years of experience in maintenance, inspections, field service or technical service environments
• Strong electrical and automation understanding
• Comfortable working with digital technologies, sensors and connected equipment
• Experience coordinating technicians, subcontractors or service activities
• Fluent Dutch and French are essential
• Good professional English skills
• Hands-on leader with strong customer focus
• Team player able to work in a structured international environment
• Proactive, pragmatic and comfortable with change

Are you passionate about category development, negotiation and commercial performance? As a Category Manager - Wholesale, you will shape the product assortment, identify new market opportunities and build strong supplier relationships. Based in Antwerp, you will play a key role in driving sales, profitability and sustainable growth within the wholesale sector.

 

 

Your responsibilities :

• Develop and optimise the product assortment throughout its lifecycle.
• Drive sales, margins and product turnover through effective category strategies and performance monitoring.
• Identify market trends and translate data into actionable growth opportunities.
• Negotiate competitive agreements, pricing and promotions while building long-term supplier partnerships.
• Collaborate with sales and marketing and coordinate purchase support and replenishment activities.
• Improve purchasing processes and operational efficiency.
 

About you :

• You have a bachelor's or master's degree and experience in purchasing, category management or commercial negotiations.
• You are analytical, commercially minded and confident in negotiations.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French and have a good command of English.
• You are proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership and working with different stakeholders.
• Experience in FMCG, food, beverages or convenience, along with knowledge of Excel and ERP systems, is an advantage.

Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and automate Azure infrastructures following Infrastructure as Code principles.
• Support container platforms based on Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
• Implement and monitor logging, alerting, and performance solutions for cloud environments.
• Maintain cloud network components, security configurations, and access management.
• Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term expertise within the team.
• Analyze existing infrastructure to resolve configuration drift and optimize operational continuity.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in an Agile environment to align security and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with cloud platforms focusing on Microsoft Azure, AKS, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
• 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including state management and modularization.
• 5+ years of experience with containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
• 5+ years of experience with CI/CD automation and version control using GitHub Actions and Git.
• 5+ years of experience with scripting for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud networking components including Azure Firewall, vWAN, VNets, and DNS.
• 3+ years of experience with monitoring and security tools such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Key Vault, and RBAC.
• Possess a proactive, result-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate a collaborative approach within multidisciplined Agile teams.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working knowledge of the other and good professional English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, CKA, or CKAD.
• Experience with GitOps principles and tooling like Flux.
• Experience working in regulated environments or the public sector.
• Familiarity with Jira for project management.
• Willingness to coach and train technical colleagues.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:

• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:

• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:

• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of electricity.
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!
 

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.
 

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:
 

 
• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
 
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations. 
 
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed. 
 
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly. 
 
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities. 

 
•  
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.
 
 
•  
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 
 
 
•  
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.
 
 
•  
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.
 
 
•  
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.
 
 
•  
You communicate well in English.
 
 
•  
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.
 
 
•  
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive local and international IT projects, including ERP and digital platform transformations.
• Support and optimize business-critical applications such as ERP, e-commerce, CRM, and customer support tools.
• Act as the go-to expert for users, system integrations, and operational excellence.
• Ensure IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection remain robust and future-ready.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to deliver seamless digital experiences.

• 5  years of experience in IT systems, applications, or project management.
• Strong ERP expertise; SAP experience is a major plus.
• Knowledge of e-commerce platforms (Shopify is a bonus).
• Broad understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and user support.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an asset.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.
